intervalScope: Existing free-plan baseline; does not meet the proposed one-minute target.

monitors.name: SentFrom trusted-provider validity
monitors.prerequisite: Deploy the optional endpoint and set PROVIDER_POLICY_MONITOR_HANDLE=monitor@mail.sentfrom.ai; it checks admission only and creates no mailbox or sign-in.

applicationRules: Inspect existing monitors and alert contacts before creating anything; reconcile by exact URL, not name alone.
Reuse the existing identity monitor, preserving unrelated monitors, contacts and account settings.
Assign only the verified support contact to these monitors; do not infer contact activation or delivery from a successful API response.
Do not purchase a plan or silently claim one-minute checks.
Record monitor IDs, exact saved URLs, intervals, expected status/keyword and alert routing after readback.

deliveryDrill.scope: A clearly labelled, dedicated synthetic monitor; never stop production or weaken an actual health check.
deliveryDrill.failure: Use an observed fixed nonexistent path on the owned public application, verify its 404 response, and let the dedicated monitor detect the failure normally.
deliveryDrill.recovery: Update only that synthetic monitor to the observed healthy readiness URL, then require a normal UP event.
deliveryDrill.evidence: Provider incident/activity records plus receipt of the labelled DOWN and UP alerts at support@sentfrom.ai. A Test Notification alone does not prove detection.
deliveryDrill.cleanup: Pause the dedicated synthetic monitor after the drill; never remove production monitors.

pending: Named response hours and backup/escalation contact.
Backup-job failure and age alerts after the real backup job is deployed.
